name: How perfect You are O...
arabic: ((سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّنَا وَبِحَمْدِكَ، اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي)).

transliterations.latin: Subhaneke All-llahumme Rabbena ve bihamdike, All-llahumme-gfir li

translations.albanian: I Lartësuar qofsh o Allah, Zoti ynë, Ty të takon Falënderimi. O Allah, më fal mua.
translations.english: (How perfect You are O Allah, our Lord and I praise You.  O Allah, forgive me.)
translations.indonesian: Maha Suci Tuhanku yang Maha Agung". (Dibaca tiga kali).49
